question: Question linked to image n ° 16 If the patient is treated surgically with adequate resection margins, what prognosis do you consider most likely?

options.opa: Healing very likely, with moderate possibility of local recurrence and very remote possibility of distant metastasis.
options.opb: Local recurrence with an approximate probability of 50%.
options.opc: Probability of lymph node metastasis greater than 50%.
options.opd: Probability of distant metastasis greater than 30%.
options.ope: In this case, surgical treatment should not be considered as the only therapeutic option.
